Name: Mix All The Seeds
Author: mushymato
Description:
[left]Features
[list=1]
[*]Mixed seeds can now become any in-season non-flower crop.[/*]
[*]Mixed flower seeds can now become any in-season flower crop.[/*]
[*]You can unmix mixed seeds (vanilla as well as item extensions) with the seed maker.[/*]
[/list]Additionally you can configure mixed seeds in these ways:[/left]
[left][list=1]
[*]Exclude Regrowing Crops: Exclude any crops that regrow from mixed seeds/mixed flower seeds.[/*]
[*]Exclude Unpassable Crops: Exclude any crops that are raised and not passable.[/*]
[*]Exclude Rare Crops: Exclude any crops that can't be bought from Pierre or Joja from mixed seeds/mixed flower seeds.[/*]
[/list][/left]
[left]
These can all be toggled on/off with GMCM.
